title: Data & Sheets
tagline: Automate financial models, statistical transformations, and complex formulas

cases.title: SaaS Unit Economics & Cohort Retention
cases.description: Calculate CAC payback, LTV, net revenue retention (NRR), and churn curves across customer cohorts.
cases.prompt: Build a SaaS unit economics model with formulas for LTV/CAC ratio, payback months, and quarterly retention cohorts.

cases.title: Automate Dynamic Excel/Sheets Formulas
cases.description: Generate resilient XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and dynamic array formulas with nested error handling.
cases.prompt: Construct an Excel formula using XLOOKUP and LET to match multi-condition transactions and fallback to fuzzy search.
cases.sample_output:
```excel
=LET(
  match_val, XLOOKUP(1, (Orders!A:A=A2)*(Orders!B:B=B2), Orders!C:C, ""),
  IF(match_val="", XLOOKUP(""&A2&"*", Orders!A:A, Orders!C:C, "Not Found", 2), match_val)
)
```

cases.title: Data Pipeline Outlier Cleaning & Normalization
cases.description: Detect data anomalies, impute missing values, and normalize skewed distributions using robust z-scores.
cases.prompt: Generate a Python data cleaning script to normalize raw transaction logs, remove outliers via IQR, and export validated CSV.
cases.sample_output: Outlier detection script executed: 42 records flagged outside 3.0 IQR threshold. Imputed null timestamps and formatted currency fields.

cases.title: Multi-Scenario DCF Valuation Model
cases.description: Perform discounted cash flow valuation across bull, base, and bear macroeconomic conditions.
cases.prompt: Create a DCF valuation model with variable WACC (8%-12%) and terminal growth rates (2%-4%) across 3 economic scenarios.
